author: lumeolab
text:
No f*cking way.

A 15-year-old started the biggest GTA 6 PC port project on the internet.

Almost 180,000 people joined the Discord.

Rockstar took it down within days.

What happened:
→ Nov 19: GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox only
→ a near-complete Xbox build leaks, the missing executable follows on Nov 23
→ Project Leonida starts recompiling it for Windows. 26,503 shaders translated to Vulkan
→ Discord server gone, GitHub page gone, a 2-year Discord ban
→ the creator is stepping away to focus on school

Rockstar still hasn't given PC a date.

Was Rockstar right to kill it?
